attributes.additional_details: Call a General Election! The establishment fails British taxpayers and ignores our voices. Mass migration is out of control, crime is rising, and our families are left unsafe. For wanting safe streets and a better future for our children, we are wrongly labelled. Our ancestors built and forged this great, sovereign nation. It is deeply disrespectful to ignore their legacy. It is time to put English, Welsh, Scottish, and Northern Irish people first. Let the people decide!
attributes.background: The government is failing taxpayers. We need action on migration and crime to make communities safe. Previous generations built this nation, but our views are ignored. It is time to put English, Welsh, Scottish, and Northern Irish people first. Let the people decide.

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign the following petition, which calls for similar action:

General election now – and always call one if a PM is replaced
